messages.content:
Title: Diagnosis
Details: The test failure occurs when parsing a CSV with a header containing empty strings and the CSVFormat is configured with a nullString of "" and ignoreEmptyHeaders set to true. The test triggers a NullPointerException.

From the code analysis:
- The test uses CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withHeader().withNullString("").withIgnoreEmptyHeaders(true).
- The CSVFormat.withHeader() method constructs a new CSVFormat with an empty header array (since no explicit headers are passed).
- When CSVParser is initialized, it calls initializeHeader() to set up the header map.
- In initializeHeader(), if formatHeader.length==0, the header is read from the first line of the input—a CSV record splitting "a,,c,,d".
- Then, for each header string, it checks if the header is empty by calling header.trim().isEmpty().
- If the header is empty and ignoreEmptyHeaders is true, duplicate headers with empty strings are allowed.
- However, the code calls hdrMap.put(header, index) with header potentially being an empty string "".
- Later, in other CSV parsing logic (not fully shown here), keys in the mapping or other operations on header strings may cause a NullPointerException due to inconsistent handling of empty headers combined with the nullString being "".

The core suspect is that the nullString == "" conflicts with empty headers when ignoreEmptyHeaders=true, causing improper handling or mapping of empty header keys. The NullPointerException likely arises because the code assumes headers are never equal to the nullString or empty, but here they are both "".

The fix involves adding safe guards to handle empty headers when nullString == "" especially with ignoreEmptyHeaders=true, ensuring the header map doesn't get malformed with "" entries or that subsequent parsing checks handle this case gracefully.

Recent bug reports do not provide additional evidence, so the issue is isolated to the interaction of empty headers and nullString == "" in CSVParser.initializeHeader.

Hence, the bug arises from insufficent consistency checks and handling in CSVParser.initializeHeader when nullString == "" combined with empty headers and ignoreEmptyHeaders=true configuration.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
